_comment: multiple-version line, MC 1.16.5 fabric, smoke env: no target mod, only fabric-api, to isolate JECh loading. This variant has no JEI integration at all. Launched through the checkout's own Gradle run task (gradle launch): architectury-loom's `:1.16.5:fabric:runClient` registers the module's own sources as the mod under test and carries fabric-api through `modApi`, so both ride that run's classpath (via=dev-classpath) and no jar is staged into mods/. The wrapper is Gradle 8.1.1, which cannot run on the machine's default JDK (JBR 25), so daemon_java is 17; the client itself is the module's own Java 8 toolchain.
